slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 26m to GBP 640m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 26m to GBP 640m
Total reserve: GBP 640m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 26m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,968.1m
The principal increases were Casualty +GBP 18m and Property +GBP 7m.
Marine released GBP 3m following favourable development.
4 projection-method selections changed since 2026 Q1, concentrated in Casualty and Property.
Casualty strengthening of GBP 18m is the dominant feature; recent accident years are the main contributors and further emergence will be reviewed quarterly.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Casualty: strengthened GBP 18m. Strengthening is concentrated in recent accident years, supported by method changes and a higher inflation assumption.
Property: strengthened GBP 7m. Experience is within expectation; catastrophe exposure is monitored seasonally.
Motor: strengthened GBP 4m. Frequency and severity trends remain within expectation.
Marine: released GBP 3m. Favourable development has supported a measured release.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Casualty remains the dominant uncertainty: recent accident years have been strengthened materially and further adverse emergence cannot be ruled out.
Three Casualty selections and one Property selection changed projection method this quarter; the revised basis will be reassessed next quarter.
The claims inflation assumption for Casualty has been raised to 5.5%; sensitivity to this assumption is significant for immature years.
A management loading is held for two late-reported large liability claims still under review.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
Reserves increased GBP 26m to GBP 640m, led by Casualty. The strengthening responds to sustained adverse emergence; the next review will focus on whether the revised basis is holding.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 640m
